description: British Airways Concorde 'Alpha Charlie', flagship of the BA Concorde fleet and the aircraft that made the type's final flight into Manchester in October 2003. Kept in a purpose-built glass-sided hangar. On display at the Runway Visitor Park beside Manchester Airport; guided interior tours are sold separately.

Hawker Siddeley Trident 3B in British Airways colours, one of very few Tridents preserved anywhere. On display at the Runway Visitor Park beside Manchester Airport; guided interior tours are sold separately.

The Avro RJX-100 prototype, the last airliner designed and fully built in the United Kingdom; the RJX programme was cancelled in 2001 after only three aircraft flew. On display at the Runway Visitor Park beside Manchester Airport; guided interior tours are sold separately.

Forward fuselage only. Nose section of the ex Monarch Airlines McDonnell Douglas DC-10-30 G-DMCA, construction number 48266, used for cabin-service training and displayed to visitors. On display at the Runway Visitor Park beside Manchester Airport; guided interior tours are sold separately.

Hawker Siddeley Nimrod MR.2 coded 31, flown into Manchester in 2010 at the end of RAF Nimrod operations and preserved outdoors. Last confirmed present May 2025. On display at the Runway Visitor Park beside Manchester Airport; guided interior tours are sold separately.
